boards.title: Your First Weekend at Georgia College & State University, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A Friday-to-Sunday sequence for learning the campus, finding student resources, eating nearby, and exploring Milledgeville safely.

cards.title: Start Where Campus Opens Up
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · Front Campus
cards.notes: Begin under the Front Campus pergola, open the official campus map, and identify your routes to the library, union, and classrooms.
cards.short_summary: Use the university’s central lawn as a visual anchor before the weekend gets busy.
cards.evidence_claim: Georgia College identifies Front Campus as an orientation check-in site, and its official campus map lists Front Campus among major campus features.
cards.source_title: Campus Maps | Georgia College & State University
cards.access_notes: Outdoor campus location; follow posted event, building, and parking restrictions.

cards.title: Learn the Library Before You Need It
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · Russell Library
cards.notes: Walk through the library, locate reservable study rooms, and note how to request research help or borrow technology for classwork.
cards.short_summary: A short orientation lap turns the library into a usable academic base.
cards.evidence_claim: Russell Library provides research consultations, technology checkout, study-room reservations, and free access to listed academic information resources.
cards.source_title: Ina Dillard Russell Library | Georgia College & State University
cards.access_notes: Consult the library’s linked hours page before visiting; some resources require university credentials.

cards.title: Find the Student-Life Starting Point
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · Maxwell Student Union
cards.notes: Locate Student Engagement, scan current organization information, and save one group or activity you may want to investigate later.
cards.short_summary: The union provides a concrete first stop for turning interests into campus connections.
cards.evidence_claim: The Office of Student Engagement is based in Maxwell Student Union and connects students with events, activities, service opportunities, and more than 150 organizations.
cards.source_title: Office of Student Engagement | Georgia College & State University
cards.access_notes: Organization offices and activities follow their own schedules; check official listings before going.

cards.title: Practice Your First Campus Meal
cards.subtitle: Friday evening · The MAX
cards.notes: Check the live dining-hours page, bring your Bobcat Card or another accepted payment method, and learn the dining-hall layout over dinner.
cards.short_summary: Use one meal to understand where central-campus dining fits into your routine.
cards.evidence_claim: The MAX is the university dining hall on the street level of Maxwell Student Union and is an on-campus location accepting the Bobcat Card.
cards.access_notes: Dining schedules change by academic week and break; verify the current service period before arriving.

cards.title: End Friday with a Downtown Reset
cards.subtitle: Friday evening · Blackbird Coffee on West Hancock Street
cards.notes: Walk downtown with a friend, choose a nonalcoholic drink or snack if you want one, and use the café as a simple end point for Friday.
cards.short_summary: A named downtown café gives the first evening a clear, walkable destination.
cards.evidence_claim: Blackbird Coffee is a family-friendly coffeehouse at 114 West Hancock Street with posted Friday and Saturday hours from 7 a.m. to 10 p.m.
cards.access_notes: The current state tourism listing posts Friday and Saturday hours of 7 a.m.–10 p.m.; confirm with the business before a late visit.

cards.title: Take a Saturday Morning River Walk
cards.subtitle: Saturday morning · Oconee River Greenway
cards.notes: Follow a paved path or boardwalk at an easy pace, stay within the developed park, and turn around with enough daylight for the return.
cards.short_summary: Start Saturday outdoors on a documented riverside trail close to downtown.
cards.evidence_claim: The Oconee River Greenway at 420 East Green Street offers nearly three miles of paved paths, boardwalks, and trails and is open daily from sunrise to sunset.
cards.access_notes: Open seven days from sunrise to sunset. Remain on developed routes and use extra care near the river and boat ramp.

cards.title: Connect Campus to Georgia History
cards.subtitle: Saturday midday · Old Governor’s Mansion
cards.notes: Arrive before an hourly tour, bring your student identification, and listen for how the site interprets both free and enslaved occupants.
cards.short_summary: The university’s founding building adds historical context to the central campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The Mansion offers public student-docent tours, interprets its free and enslaved occupants, and grants free admission to Georgia College students.
cards.source_title: Tour the Mansion | Old Governor's Mansion
cards.access_notes: Walk-ins are welcome Tuesday–Saturday 10 a.m.–4 p.m. and Sunday 2–4 p.m.; tours start hourly, with holiday closures listed online.

cards.entity_name: Andalusia: The Home of Flannery O'Connor
cards.title: See an Alumna’s Working Landscape
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon · Andalusia
cards.notes: Allow an hour for the house tour and grounds, bring your student identification, and use the designated lot and Interpretive Center.
cards.short_summary: The preserved farm links a Georgia College alumna’s writing to a specific Milledgeville place.
cards.evidence_claim: Andalusia was Flannery O'Connor's home from 1951 to 1964, offers public tours, and provides free admission to GCSU students.
cards.access_notes: Tours run Tuesday–Saturday 10 a.m.–4 p.m. and Sunday 2–4 p.m.; the site states that Andalusia is not ADA accessible.

cards.title: Learn Your West Campus Recreation Base
cards.subtitle: Saturday late afternoon · West Campus
cards.notes: Bring your Bobcat ID, tour the available activity areas, and check the operational-hours page for semester changes before choosing a workout.
cards.short_summary: A low-pressure walkthrough makes the recreation center easier to use later.
cards.evidence_claim: The 100,000-square-foot Wellness and Recreation Center on West Campus houses Wellness and Recreation, Student Health Services, and Counseling Services.
cards.source_title: Wellness & Recreation | Georgia College & State University
cards.access_notes: Entry policies apply, and hours change with semesters, holidays, breaks, and events; check the current schedule and bring university ID.

cards.title: Close the Weekend with a Campus Loop
cards.subtitle: Sunday afternoon · Central Campus
cards.notes: Use the official mobile campus map to retrace the library, union, and Front Campus, then save the routes you will need on Monday.
cards.short_summary: A final daylight loop converts weekend discoveries into a practical weekday map.
cards.evidence_claim: Georgia College provides a mobile-optimized interactive campus map with searchable locations, parking information, photos, and building descriptions.
cards.source_title: Campus Maps | Georgia College & State University
cards.access_notes: Keep the loop outdoors unless a building is posted open; consult the accessibility map for accessible campus routes.

warnings: Dining, recreation, library, museum, and business hours can change during breaks or holidays; verify the linked source before departure.
